_comment: Single source of truth for constants that exist on both the JS and PHP sides. Imported via JSON in src/components/constants.js (webpack handles JSON natively) and read via motion_blocks_shared_constants() in animation-plugin.php. Adding a new shared constant: add it here, then expose it through both consumer paths.
_README_effects: Effect values offered by the Motion Effects panel, in dropdown order. Labels live in src/components/constants.js (TYPE_LABELS / EXIT_TYPE_LABELS / DIRECTION_LABELS), keyed by these values. PHP reads the lists to build the smoke-test page (tests/self-check/fixtures.php), so a new effect added here is tested automatically. animationTypes is the Scroll Interactive list; Page Load shows the same list minus the -out variants and Scroll Appear uses entryTypes / exitTypes. Image effect types are only offered on imageEffect blocks.
_README_easingPresets: Spring curves offered in the Acceleration menu. The stored acceleration value is the linear() string itself; agent recipes (includes/recipe.php) refer to them by name.
_README_effectCatalog: Label and plain-language description of every effect, keyed by the values above. The single source for the panel's effect labels (TYPE_LABELS / EXIT_TYPE_LABELS in src/components/constants.js), for agents (get-effects, includes/recipe.php) and for the generated reference schema/README.md. exitLabel is the Scroll Appear Exit slot's wording; defaultDirection is what plays when no direction is set (the CSS fallback). Every effect in animationTypes / entryTypes / exitTypes must have an entry (tests/unit/recipe-coverage.test.js).

fade.label: Fade In
fade.description: Fades from transparent to fully visible. In an Exit it fades away.

slide.label: Slide In
slide.description: Fades in while moving 50px into place from one side. In an Exit it fades out moving 50px towards that side.

slide-out.label: Slide Out
slide-out.description: Fades out while moving 50px away in the chosen direction.

wipe.label: Wipe
wipe.description: Reveals the block with a straight edge sweeping across it (a clip-path wipe), without fading. In an Exit it wipes the block away.

curtain.label: Curtain Open
curtain.description: Reveals the block from the centre outwards, like curtains opening. In an Exit it closes from the edges inwards.

curtain-out.label: Curtain Close
curtain-out.description: Hides the block from the edges inwards, like curtains closing.

flip.label: Flip
flip.description: Fades in while turning 90 degrees into place in 3D, like a card flipping over. In an Exit it flips away.

scale.label: Scale In
scale.description: Fades in while growing from 75% to full size. A direction adds a 50px drift from that side; "none" scales in place. In an Exit it shrinks away.

scale-out.label: Scale Out
scale-out.description: Fades out while shrinking to 75%, optionally drifting 50px in the chosen direction.

blur.label: Blur In
blur.description: Fades in while going from blurred to sharp. Set the starting blur with `blur` (px, default 8). In an Exit it blurs away.

blur-out.label: Blur Out
blur-out.description: Fades out while blurring (`blur` sets the amount in px, default 8).

rotate.label: Rotate In
rotate.description: Fades in while turning into place from an angle. Set the angle with `rotate` (degrees, default 90; negative turns the other way). In an Exit it turns away.

rotate-out.label: Rotate Out
rotate-out.description: Fades out while turning by `rotate` degrees (default 90).

image-move.label: Image Move (Beta)
image-move.description: Cover blocks with an image background only. Pans the background image (enlarged to 120%) across the frame in the chosen direction while the text stays still. Best with Scroll Interactive, for a parallax feel.

image-zoom.label: Image Zoom (Beta)
image-zoom.description: Cover blocks with an image background only. Slowly zooms the background image from 100% to 120% while the text stays still.

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Your own start and end values, in `from` and `to`: opacity, translateX, translateY, scale, rotate, rotateX, rotateY, blur and clipPath. Anything left out stays at the block's normal look.

_README_directionLabels: Labels for every direction value in `directions` (and "none" for Scale).
_README_propertyDefaultUnits: Unit a bare number gets for each Custom From / To property ("" = unitless). Must match PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS in src/components/constants.js (tests/unit/recipe-coverage.test.js).
_README_schemaDefaults: 'schemaDefaults' is the SCHEMA default of each animation attribute: the value an attribute has when it is missing from a block's saved comment. WordPress omits any attribute equal to its schema default when it saves a block, and refills it from the schema when the editor loads the block. So this map defines what every omitted key means, on both sides:
- JS: addAnimationAttributes in src/index.js registers each attribute with `default: SCHEMA_DEFAULTS.<key>`.

- PHP: motion_blocks_render_block merges this map under the saved attributes before reading them, so the front end resolves omitted keys exactly as the editor does. motion_blocks_attr_default() reads the same map.

Changing a value here changes the effective setting of every existing block that relied on the old default, in the editor and on the front end alike. Treat the values as frozen unless that is the intent.

What a NEW block gets when the user picks a mode lives in DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES in src/components/constants.js (JS only). It starts from this map and overrides a few keys: animationDelay and animationEntryDelay are 0 for new blocks but 0.4 here, because blocks saved before that preference changed rely on 0.4. The mode picker writes the preference explicitly, and since it differs from the schema default it is serialized into the block comment.
Not listed: attributes whose schema default is null (Custom From/To values) and editor-only UI state. A missing key already means 'not set' to PHP.
